title: Aamir Khan Expects Final 3 Idiots Sequel Script Narration in Coming Weeks
excerpt: At the Singapore International Film Festival, Aamir Khan said Rajkumar Hirani is working on the sequel script — but the project remains in writing, with no shooting schedule or release date.
body:
• Aamir Khan said Rajkumar Hirani is working on the 3 Idiots sequel script and hopes to narrate the final version to him in the next couple of weeks after he returns to Mumbai.
  • Khan shared the update at the Singapore International Film Festival, where he received the Screen Icon Award on October 22; he said he checked with Hirani before revealing it.
  • The sequel remains in the writing stage, with no official shooting schedule or release date announced.
  • Khan has previously described the story as unusual, with the same humour as the 2009 film, following the characters 10 years later.

Aamir Khan has confirmed that director Rajkumar Hirani is working on the script for a sequel to 3 Idiots and expects to hear its final version in the coming weeks. Khan shared the update during a conversation at the Singapore International Film Festival (SGIFF), where he received the festival's Screen Icon Award on October 22, according to Variety India.

"Well, I'm not allowed to say a lot. I think I can say this much, that yes, Raju is working on the script. In fact, hopefully once I'm back in the next couple of weeks, he's going to narrate the final version to me. So, fingers crossed."

https://youtube.com/watch?v=S2NWltJ6H2I — Aamir Khan, actor

Bollywood Hungama reported that Khan checked with Hirani before speaking about the project and whether he could reveal the latest development. That caution matters: the sequel is still being written, and Khan disclosed no plot details, production timeline or casting beyond the creative team's work so far.

Still in the Writing Stage

Both reports stress the same limit on the news. The project has not reached shooting, and there is no official announcement of a filming schedule or release date. Khan's expectation of a narration in the next couple of weeks is a milestone in development, not a green light for production. Reports earlier this year speculated that filming could begin around April 2027 after Khan completes other commitments, Bollywood Hungama noted, but there has been no official confirmation of those plans.

https://x.com/abplive/status/2113698551297724897

The sequel was first discussed in April this year. In an interview with Amar Ujala cited by Bollywood Hungama, Khan said Hirani was working on 3 Idiots 2, that he had heard the story and found it wonderful, and that the screenplay still required further work. He described the idea as unusual, with the same humour as the first film, following the characters 10 years later.

Why the Original Still Travels

Released in 2009, 3 Idiots brought together Khan, R Madhavan and Sharman Joshi as three engineering students navigating an unforgiving education system, alongside Kareena Kapoor Khan and Boman Irani. Directed by Hirani and written by Hirani and Abhijat Joshi, it became one of Hindi cinema's most successful films, built on a critique of rote learning, parental expectations and the pursuit of conventional success.

For diaspora audiences, that critique was the export. The film played to families who recognised its examination-hall pressure and its argument for following aptitude over status, and it widened Khan's audience in China as well — a reach Khan himself discussed in Singapore, while making clear he opposed the piracy that helped circulate it there. A sequel that returns to the characters a decade later will be judged first on whether it can speak to those same pressures in adult life: careers, families and the cost of choices made at 20.

A Festival Appearance About More Than a Sequel

The Singapore conversation ranged well beyond one project. Khan looked back at signing nine or ten films within six months after Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak (1988) and the failures that left him emotionally drained, a period that taught him to commit only to scripts, directors and producers he believed in. He also spoke about the personal cost of three decades of work, a realisation sharpened during Covid, and his effort since then to make more time for family. The festival also marked 25 years of Lagaan with a special screening, and Khan received the Screen Icon Award from Hong Kong filmmaker Peter Chan.

What to Watch

The next concrete step is the narration itself. If Khan approves the final script, expect questions about whether Madhavan, Joshi, Kareena Kapoor Khan and Boman Irani return, who produces, and when cameras roll. Until a production announcement arrives, the accurate status is simple: a beloved film's sequel is being written by its original director, its star expects to hear the finished script within weeks, and nothing has been scheduled.
